messages:
Nina (Marketing): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: need a tight one-liner about our mission for the webinar slide. @Claire?
Claire (CEO): Use: 'Make production-grade LLM inference predictable and economical.' Keep it punchy.
Omar (Solutions): Can we have a single sentence to explain why customers pick Redwood over self-hosting?
Raj (VP Product): Suggest: 'Same API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments, with built-in rollouts, tracing, and cost controls.'
Lydia (Engineering): Small ask: keep heavy infra terms off marketing. We'll provide a short non-tech blurb for benchmarks/tech docs.
Claire (CEO): Agree. Marketing = benefits. Tech docs = specifics.
Nina (Marketing): Timeline: when will we get the hero line and a short Dedicated vs Private differentiator?
Raj (VP Product): Hero + differentiator in 7 business days. Dedicated = reserved cloud capacity with SLA; Private = customer-managed networking or on-prem.
ops-bot: Slides uploaded: https://redwood-inference.slides/ah-2052223333
Claire (CEO): One more: emphasize "predictable inference economics" in the deck. I'll review copy Friday 9am PT.
Nina (Marketing): Thanks — will post draft in #marketing when ready.
thread_text_summary: Follow-up Q&A clarifying a mission one-liner, a concise competitor rebuttal vs self-hosting, marketing vs technical messaging separation, Dedicated vs Private differentiation, timelines for updated copy, and slide upload.
